identity_description: Exact nonblank native string ptrOrderId, distinct from caseId; native gmtModified is required integer milliseconds.
limitations: GET /api/ptr/manage/query.json on iglobalfundcontrol.alipay.com, pageNo=0/pageSize=500 and only bound modifiedTimeBegin/modifiedTimeEnd. Application entry: https://ifundcontrol.alipay.com/productOperation/paymentProductManagement/productPTRManagement/orderInquiry.

Explicit second-precision numeric offsets only; normalize instants to Shanghai +08:00. Reject unknown -00:00, fractional seconds, missing offsets, nonordered spans, spans exceeding 31 days and future upper bounds.

Each native query expands both boundaries by one second. Each padded read must prove native total/unique identity coverage within fixed width 500; 500 is the scoped fixed policy, not a measured backend maximum.
Read the same padded scope twice under one shared request/deadline budget. Compare retained projections sorted by native ptrOrderId before trimming; changed padding records fail too.
After full padded stability, retain start <= gmtModified < end, sorted lexically by ptrOrderId. Padded native totals and both acquisition records remain in evidence; public output count is separate.

Preserve the assigned PTR field allowlist, retained debtorAmount/returnAmount money keys and productionTrialRunFundOutAbilityVO baseline keys. Unknown fields are omitted; no money normalization or derived verification interpretation.

Exact local scalar/nested whole-string filters only. Live never publishes; complete nonempty refresh publishes, and failed/incomplete/empty refresh preserves the saved snapshot. Offline uses the saved window; explicit acquisition bounds require a fresh live query.
List only; no Get, execution, trial, withdrawal, approval or update action. No new Duckdog import.
